executive_pulse: CISA added N-able MailAssure (SSRF) and Project MONAI MONAI Label (path traversal) to KEV following confirmed active exploitation. ConnectWise ScreenConnect client exploitation targeting MSP technicians has also been reported.

items.headline: CISA Adds N-able MailAssure SSRF (CVE-2026-134624) to KEV Following Breach
items.summary: N-able disclosed a critical SSRF vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check of MailAssure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud. Discovered during a breach investigation, the flaw allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts/ports and relay data.
items.action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA BOD 26-04 cloud service directives by November 26, 2026.
items.hunt: MailAssure API logs: unexpected internal IP addresses or internal port scans initiated via LDAP sync connection checks.

compensating_controls: Restrict the server's outbound traffic to required destinations only
Block access to cloud instance metadata from the application (for example IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 on AWS)
remediation.verify: Review egress and metadata-service access logs from the affected host

items.headline: CISA KEV Addition: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal (CVE-2026-133968)
items.summary: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write arbitrary files outside the designated datastore directory, potentially leading to arbitrary remote code execution.
items.action: Apply mitigations per vendor advisory instructions and ensure compliance with CISA BOD 26-04 guidance.
items.hunt: Web application logs: HTTP request parameters to MONAI Label endpoints containing directory traversal sequences (../) targeting write operations.

compensating_controls: Remove internet exposure of the affected interface until patched
Apply WAF or IPS signatures from your vendor for the CVE, in blocking mode
Run the service as a non-privileged user and restrict outbound connections
remediation.verify: Hunt for shells or scripting engines spawned by the affected service, and new scheduled tasks or cron entries

items.headline: Active Exploitation of ConnectWise ScreenConnect Client Vulnerability (CVE-2026-84869)
items.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical ConnectWise ScreenConnect client vulnerability (CVSS 9.9) targeting MSP servers. The flaw enables a guest to transfer and execute arbitrary payloads directly onto a connecting technician's host machine.
items.action: Update all ConnectWise ScreenConnect server and client components to patched releases immediately.
items.hunt: EDR telemetry: unexpected child process execution or file creation under ScreenConnect client processes on technician endpoints.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: Critical Azure Event Grid Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-62841)
items.summary: Improper authentication in Azure Event Grid allows an unauthorized remote attacker to elevate privileges across the network (CVSS 10.0).
items.action: Verify Microsoft cloud service security updates are applied automatically or updated per MSRC deployment notes.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event

items.headline: Xen Orchestra xo-server REST Token Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-133469)
items.summary: Parsing REST cookies converts empty JSON objects into token queries that xo-server treats as unfiltered lookups, authenticating remote attackers as the owner of the first active token (CVSS 9.8).
items.action: Update xo-server npm package to patched versions resolving GHSA-2r3w-c2vx-fv5g.
items.hunt: Web server logs: HTTP request Cookie headers containing authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event
